title: MONDAY LEGS AND LUNGS
subtitle: MONDAY. LEGS AND LUNGS. OPEN THE BACK, OWN THE BALANCE, THEN LEGS AND BREATH. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE TOMORROW.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. MONDAY. LEGS AND LUNGS. FIFTEEN MINUTES. OPEN THE BACK, OWN THE BALANCE, THEN LEGS AND BREATH. DO NOT HIDE BEHIND THAT KEYBOARD, YOU LAZY SOD.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. MOVE YOUR ARSE.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. DO NOT COLLAPSE INTO THE FURNITURE.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. MONDAY LEGS AND LUNGS DONE. LEGS HONEST. LUNGS OPEN. NOW GET BACK TO WORK WITHOUT MOVING LIKE A BLOODY FILING CABINET.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: SCAPULAR ROW
exercises.cue: STAND TALL OR HINGE LIGHT. PULL THE SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN SLOW. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH AND POSTURE OPENER. NO YANKING.
exercises.speakStart: SCAPULAR ROWS. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. PULL THE SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH WORK. OPEN THE BACK AFTER THAT DESK. DO NOT YANK LIKE YOU ARE STARTING A LAWNMOWER.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE SHOULDERS LOOSE.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGE
exercises.cue: STEP BACK. FRONT KNEE TRACKS THE TOE. CHEST UP. LIGHT HAND ON A CHAIR IF YOU NEED IT. OWN THE BALANCE.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. TWO SETS. SIX EACH LEG. STEP BACK. CHEST UP. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. DO NOT WOBBLE ABOUT LIKE A BLOODY WEATHERVANE.

exercises.name: BODYWEIGHT SQUAT
exercises.cue: FEET ABOUT HIP WIDTH. SIT BACK. CHEST UP. STEADY DOWN, DRIVE UP. LEGS WORK. QUALITY BEATS RUSHING.
exercises.speakStart: BODYWEIGHT SQUATS. TWO SETS OF TEN. SIT BACK. CHEST UP. THIS IS YOUR LEG STRENGTH. DO NOT BOUNCE LIKE A BLOODY PING PONG BALL.

exercises.name: STEP-UP
exercises.cue: USE A STAIR OR STURDY STEP. DRIVE THROUGH THE WHOLE FOOT. STAND TALL AT THE TOP. CONTROL THE LOWER. LIGHT HAND ON A RAIL IF NEEDED.
exercises.speakStart: STEP UPS. TWO SETS. EIGHT EACH LEG. DRIVE UP. STAND TALL. THIS IS LEGS AND LUNGS. DO NOT STOMP LIKE YOU ARE KILLING SPIDERS.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. CATCH YOUR BREATH. EYES ON YOU.

exercises.name: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS
exercises.cue: HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS. HIPS LEVEL. DRIVE KNEES IN ALTERNATE. STEADY RHYTHM. BREATHE. OFFICE-SCALED. NOT A SPRINT TO THE GRAVE.
exercises.speakStart: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS. TWO ROUNDS. TWENTY SECONDS. HANDS SET. HIPS LEVEL. STEADY KNEE DRIVE. THIS IS YOUR LUNGS WORK. DO NOT FLOP ABOUT LIKE A PANICKED CATERPILLAR.

exercises.name: GLUTE BRIDGE
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK. FEET FLAT. DRIVE THROUGH THE HEELS. SQUEEZE AT THE TOP. SLOW LOWER. CONTROL BEATS BOUNCING.
exercises.speakStart: GLUTE BRIDGES. TWO SETS OF TEN. DRIVE THROUGH THE HEELS. SQUEEZE AT THE TOP. SLOW LOWER. THIS IS YOUR HIP FINISH. DO NOT THRUST LIKE YOU ARE AUDITIONING FOR A BLOODY MUSIC VIDEO.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE HIPS LOOSE.
exercises.speakDone: BRIDGES DONE. THAT IS THE LOT.
